title: Automaton 2000 Micro - Dodging Siege Tanks
summary: A StarCraft 2 custom-map demo where a bot controls 100 zerglings against 20 sieged tanks and dodges the splash damage, leaving 19 survivors. The code was written in Blizzard's World Editor.
why: Cited in StarCraft and AI threads as a vivid example of superhuman micro and of machine speed advantage over humans.

quote.text: Zerglings vs Siege Tanks when controlled by AI with perfect micro.
